summary.text: Rob Sand is Iowa's State Auditor, the only Democrat currently holding statewide elected office in Iowa, and the Democratic nominee for governor. He previously served as an assistant attorney general and was first elected auditor in 2018. His campaign emphasizes bipartisanship and fixing the state budget, and he supports ending the privatization of Iowa's Medicaid system and opposes new restrictions on abortion.

paragraphs.text: Born in Decorah, Iowa; earned a bachelor's degree from Brown University (2005) and a J.D. from the University of Iowa College of Law (2010).
Served as an Iowa assistant attorney general from 2010 to 2017, including as lead prosecutor in the Iowa Film Office tax credit fraud case.
Elected State Auditor in 2018, defeating Republican incumbent Mary Mosiman, and re-elected in 2022 by 2,893 votes.
